root_cause: After Composio OAuth became ACTIVE, the setup path only reported readiness. Publication depended on the next scheduled delivery run or a manual follow-up.
prevention: After hosted OAuth is opened, poll provider status for a bounded period only.
When exactly one active Instagram connection is observed, invoke exactly one admin-authenticated resume action.
Resume must call the canonical social publisher; never bypass identity, capability, or provider-readback gates.
Stop polling after success, timeout, destruction, or explicit failure; never persist auth state in browser storage.
